Overview

Water treatment and utility equipment under one roof

Shree Matha Enterprises focuses on water purification and treatment, from household RO purifiers to commercial RO plants, along with solar and lighting solutions and related equipment such as fogging machines, sanitation chemicals and CCTV.

We serve homes, shops, institutions and industries in and around Huvinahadagali. Prices are never one-size-fits-all, so every product is quoted on request, based on your actual requirement.

We don’t publish fixed prices. Choose Request a Quote and share your requirement for a quote.

Enquire About an RO Plant

RO capacity guide

Commercial RO capacity categories

LPH means litres per hour. The right size depends on how much water you need, your water source and quality, and how the plant will be used, so we recommend after understanding your requirement.

  • 25LPH
  • 50LPH
  • 100LPH
  • 250LPH
  • 500LPH
  • 1,000LPH
  • 2,000LPH
  • 5,000LPH

Not sure which capacity? Select Not sure, please advise in the enquiry form and describe your daily water need and location.

Installation and service

Installation and maintenance enquiries

If you need an RO plant installed, or an existing plant looked at, send us the details. The more we know, the faster we can respond sensibly.

  • Your town or village and district
  • Water source: borewell, tap, tanker or other
  • Rough daily water requirement
  • What the water will be used for
  • Plant make and capacity, if it’s an existing one

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you publish prices?

No. Pricing depends on capacity, water quality, site conditions and the product, so we give a quote after understanding your requirement. Use “Request a Quote” or send an enquiry.

Which commercial RO capacities are available?

We handle commercial RO plants in these capacity categories: 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1,000, 2,000 and 5,000 LPH. If you are not sure which suits you, choose “Not sure, please advise” in the enquiry form.

What information should I share for an RO plant enquiry?

Your location, where the water comes from (borewell, tap, tanker or other), roughly how much water you need per day, and what it will be used for. A water test report helps if you have one.

What is the difference between domestic and commercial RO?

Domestic purifiers are made for household drinking water. Commercial RO plants are built for larger daily volumes, such as shops, institutions, communities and industry.

Can I enquire about installation or maintenance?

Yes. Send an enquiry with your location and plant or product details and we’ll respond with the next steps.

Do you supply anything besides water equipment?

Yes. Shree Matha Enterprises also handles fogging machines, hygiene and sanitation chemicals, bleaching powder, solar street lights, high-mast lighting, solar panels, solar water heaters and CCTV solutions.
